descriptor: Cloud storage platform with a public status page

voice.summary: Orrin Cloud tells people what is happening during downtime in plain sentences, with times and service names rather than apologies. It is reassuring because it is specific: nothing is lost, and here is the clock.
dos: State what is happening, what is safe and when we return
Show countdowns and service states in exact terms
Apologise once, briefly, and move on
donts: Do not blame gremlins or glitches
Never use cheerful emoji during an outage

taglines: We will say when we are back
boilerplate: Orrin Cloud is a storage platform whose maintenance page shows a live countdown, per-service status and email notification, so customers always know what is happening.

microcopy.success: You will get an email when we are back.
microcopy.error: That email does not look right. Please check it.

logo.note: A cloud shape says storage at a glance and keeps the status page familiar.
